tools.name: rwa_list_assets
tools.description: Free. List authoritative Robinhood Chain Stock Token assets, optionally filtered by symbol.

tools.name: rwa_analyze_asset
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Paid on this host: $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base — unpaid calls return this host's x402 challenge; paid calls are verified and settled through OMNIGATE. Return evidence-backed asset, reference quote, multiplier, corporate-action, and risk flags.

tools.name: rwa_find_opportunities
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Paid on this host: $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base — unpaid calls return this host's x402 challenge; paid calls are verified and settled through OMNIGATE. Score a Robinhood Stock Token only from authoritative reference data and supplied venue evidence.

tools.name: rwa_compare_assets
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Paid on this host: $0.010 USDC via x402 on Base — unpaid calls return this host's x402 challenge; paid calls are verified and settled through OMNIGATE. Compare two or more Robinhood Stock Tokens using the same evidence-first opportunity engine.

tools.name: rwa_market_snapshot
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Paid on this host: $0.015 USDC via x402 on Base — unpaid calls return this host's x402 challenge; paid calls are verified and settled through OMNIGATE. Return a read-only snapshot of active Robinhood Stock Tokens without inventing venue liquidity.

tools.name: prediction_list_markets
tools.description: Free. List event markets observed on Robinhood's public prediction-markets pages. Read-only public evidence; no brokerage access, order placement, or synthetic odds.

tools.name: prediction_get_market
tools.description: Free. Inspect one official Robinhood event page: displayed contracts, cents/percent values, timeline, and resolution description. Values are observations, not SML forecasts.

tools.name: prediction_rank_attention
tools.description: Free. Rank only markets with an explicit public Robinhood volume signal. Returns partial/no rank rather than fabricating attention when volume is absent.
